Custom PP Ring Binder Folders — Engineering Summary

  • Custom PP Ring Binder Folders are quoted as a B2B project with MOQ 500 PCS.
  • Available ring mechanisms: 2-ring (A4/Letter), 3-ring (US Letter standard), 4-ring (A4 European standard).
  • Cover options: full-color offset or digital printing with matte or gloss lamination, spot UV, or embossing.
  • Spine label: custom printed with product name, logo, and ISBN/code if required.
  • Interior pockets: clear or frosted PP insert pockets front and/or rear.
  • BestPackFactory supports OEM / ODM size, ring gauge (0.5" to 3"), material, and finish customization.
  • Suitable for: corporate catalogues, school supplies, office stationery, product presentations, training manuals.
